meta.rule: A rate is a dated observation with a source URL, never a single standing value. Every row below is one observation made on the date shown. A row with no price is kept, not deleted, so the next observation can be compared against it.
meta.blocking_reason: Every official booking engine found (venetianlasvegas.com/book, wynnlasvegas.com/book, the MGM property sites, caesars.com) renders date-specific prices only inside JavaScript. A static site cannot read them, and no request from this workspace returned a price. No dated total is therefore claimed. This is the single largest gap on the site.
